description:
## Why

The sixteen `.fz` modules that make up fz's standard library live at `src/modules/runtime_library/`, inside the `fz` crate's Rust source tree. `src/` is where rustc looks; fz source is not Rust source and does not belong there.

`runtime/` is not the answer either, despite the name. That directory is the `fz-runtime` crate -- the Rust host: heap, process, `ir_runtime.rs`, the `fz_*` symbols linked into compiled programs. It never reads a `.fz` file. Every reader is `src/modules/runtime_library.rs` in the compiler crate, which `include_str!`s all sixteen. Putting the library under `runtime/lib/` would park fz source in a crate that does not consume it and make the consumer reach across a crate boundary.

A top-level `lib/` says what the directory is -- the fz standard library, the same name and role Elixir gives its own -- and keeps the `fz` crate as its owner.

## What moves

`src/modules/runtime_library/*.fz` -> `lib/*.fz`. Sixteen files. `src/modules/runtime_library.rs`, which embeds them, stays where it is: it is Rust, and it is the consumer.

## What does not move

The module name a diagnostic renders (`runtime:Kernel.fz`) comes from the `name` field of `RuntimeModuleSource`, not from the path on disk, so no fixture golden changes. The move is the sixteen `include_str!` arguments plus every prose reference to the old path. The first candidate updated `.agent/docs/{any-value,parser-syntax,specs,fixtures,semantic-authorities}.md`, `.agent/deprecated-docs/range.md` and one fixture comment in `fixtures2/behavior/enum_sort.fz`, but a cold downstream review found four stale `src/modules/runtime_library/` instructions in `guides/modules.html`, including the user-facing “add a module” path. Those guide references are part of this ticket and must be corrected in its existing commit before it closes again.

`src/compiler2/fixtures/enum_reduce_operator_ref.fz` also stays. It is a compiler test fixture, not library source, and its only consumer is `src/compiler2/transport_contract_test.rs` beside it -- the same co-location argument that keeps `runtime_library.rs` where it is. Whether compiler-test fixtures belong under `fixtures2/` is a separate question this ticket does not answer.

## Acceptance

- `lib/` holds the sixteen library sources; no library source remains under `src/`.
- Repository-wide search finds no prose or code reference to the old library directory; `guides/modules.html` names `lib/` in its architecture and extension instructions.
- Six-target gate green with no re-blessing.

comments.text: Done in a3a47bf0c. Sixteen files moved with git mv (rename-detected, zero content change), sixteen include_str! paths repointed, seven prose references updated, and runtime_library.rs's module doc now says where the sources live. Gate green with no re-blessing: lib 1971/0, matrix 639/0, aot 30/0, cli 225/0, doc, clippy, fmt.

title: Move the fz standard library out of the Rust src/ tree into a top-level lib/
